Before I make any decision, I'd like to follow my usual round-robin process: each interested neighbor should submit a complete offer-recording entry covering payment, dates, access, vehicle, and upkeep. I also want to hear from nearby residents about any practical driveway concerns. My priorities are getting the full two-month period covered, having the faded curb numbers repainted, and keeping the driveway swept weekly. Go ahead whenever you're ready.
